- A100 80GB: 18 available now, projected -2 in 30d due to other commitments

- Autoscaling: for Dedicated we can enable constrained burst policies (burst -> reserved spare pool) but that requires a commitment to a 45-day soft hold to guarantee the spare nodes during procurement finalization.

I've attached a CSV export (gpu-inventory-2026-03-15.csv) with per-cluster counts and maintenance windows. If you want, ops can create an allocation ticket and flag it "soft-hold: 45d" pending contract signature.
